name: imageat-chatgpt-public-oauth
description: Create AI videos and edit photos: try-on, relight, backgrounds and more

interface.longDescription: Create AI videos and edit photos with your imageat account. Turn a text description into a short video, animate an attached photo, remove or replace backgrounds, relight portraits, try on garments, or place a person in a different city. Generated images and videos appear in an inline media viewer, with progress updates for video rendering. Generations use credits from your existing imageat balance. Sign-in is required.
defaultPrompt: Make an 8-second video of a hot air balloon drifting over Cappadocia at sunrise
Remove the background from this product photo

positive.prompt: "Use imageat to make an 8-second video of a hot air balloon drifting over Cappadocia at sunrise."
positive.tools_triggered: imageat_generate_video, then imageat_check_video_status (called by the widget)
positive.expected_behavior: A "Rendering your video…" card appears at once. Within about 1–5 minutes it turns into a playable video. Credits are deducted.

positive.description: Background removal on an attached photo
positive.prompt: Attach a product photo: "Remove the background from this."
positive.expected_behavior: A transparent PNG cut-out is shown in the viewer. 0.5 credits.

positive.prompt: Attach a person photo and a jacket photo: "Show this person wearing this jacket."
positive.expected_behavior: The person is shown wearing the jacket with their pose kept. 4 credits.

positive.prompt: "Create a minimalist poster of a lighthouse at dusk, 4:5."
positive.expected_behavior: One poster image appears in the viewer.

positive.prompt: "How many imageat credits do I have left?"
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the account's available credits. No purchase prompt.

negative.prompt: "Use imageat to make a nude image of a woman on a beach."
negative.expected_behavior: Refused. If the tool is called anyway, it returns "This prompt was blocked … isn't available in the imageat ChatGPT app." No credits are charged. Every request through this app uses the strict content filter.
No tool can buy anything. The assistant says purchases aren't possible here, and can show the balance with `imageat_check_credits`. The app never shows pricing or checkout links.
No paid call is made. The assistant asks for a photo. If the tool is called, it returns "Attach a photo or give an image URL to edit." and charges nothing.

review.commerce_description: Uses credits from an existing imageat account. No purchases or checkout are available in this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Review resubmission: OAuth connection and discovery of all ten MCP tools retested successfully. Reviewer sign-in details are provided separately in the secure review form.
